simple.meaning: גָּשַׁשׁ (gâshash) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to feel about.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 2 times in Isaiah, beginning at Isaiah 59:10. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גָּשַׁשׁ (H1659) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: גָּשַׁשׁ (gâshash) / H1659 is traced through Isaiah 59:10 with source-language evidence and verse context.
